messages:
jordan.partnerships: FYI StratusGrid (hw/cloud partner) is requesting our SOC summary + pen-test artifacts to complete their marketplace compliance page. They want an embargoed joint announcement and a formal evidence escrow plan. Need concrete owners and handoff mechanics.

maya.security: I can take the pen-test artifact stream. Important: marketplace reviewers only see the redacted bundle. Full artifacts go into our escrow vault (no presigns). We should define the escrow pickup process (witness token + signed chain-of-custody).

kevin.sis: For SI verification we'll add a signed integration manifest, small smoke-run packet (auth/login, basic flows), and a reproducibility snippet (docker-compose + env examples). I'll produce the smoke outputs and the manifest.

nina.legal: Legal asks: embargo duration options (5d/10d/21d), explicit non-disclosure of exploit PoCs during embargo, and a clause for emergency disclosure if a critical CVE is found. We also need the filenames/TTL table to insert into the attestation.

jordan.partnerships: Proposed artifact split: (1) redacted-bundle.tar.gz -> presigned for reviewers; (2) escrow-raw-archive.enc -> Redwood-only escrow vault; (3) integration-summary.pdf -> presign allowed. Suggested TTLs: redacted presign 5 days, integration summary 10 days, debug logs 48h. Thoughts?

maya.security: 5d presign is fine. Add: checksums.index (sha256 list) must be in the redacted bundle. We'll include checksums.index + manifest.json.sig. No presigns for raw archive.

maya.security: Example presign command for gov region (different format):

aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-staging/stratusgrid/redacted-2026-04-02.tgz --expires-in 432000 --region us-gov-east-1

(432000 = 5 days)

kevin.sis: Manifest line sample (one-per-line JSON):

{"file":"stratus-fw-3.4.bin","sha256":"9a2c...f7ab","size":3145728}

kevin.sis: We'll gzip+gpg-sign the manifest: manifest.json.gz.sig. CI signs with infra:key-managed. Provide verification steps in README.

evidence-bot: Created escrow path: escrow/stratusgrid/2026-04-02/ (owner=jordan.partnerships). Redacted staging path: staging/stratusgrid/ (auto-delete=7d default).

maya.security: Redaction policy draft: remove MACs/serials, replace internal IPs with 10.x placeholders, strip hostnames with host-XXXX placeholders, mask email addresses, and redact raw pcap payloads. Keep metadata (timestamps) intact. Mapping doc kept in vault only.

nina.legal: I will prepare three embargo templates: 5d, 10d, 21d. Each will include signature blocks for StratusGrid legal, Redwood Eng lead, and Redwood legal. Also drafting emergency-disclosure clause. Need final file list + TTLs to lock the text.

jordan.partnerships: Owner recap & ETA: maya.security = redacted bundle + checksums + redaction rules by 2026-04-02 EOD; kevin.sis = signed manifest + integration summary + repro snippet by 2026-04-02; nina.legal = embargo templates by 2026-04-01. Partner sync scheduled 2026-03-30.

evidence-bot: Note: retention policies -> staging redacted artifacts auto-delete after 7 days. Escrow vault retains encrypted raw archives for 90 days by default. Override requires evidence-admins approval.

maya.security: I'll add an internal 'witness token' process: partner SI must supply an authenticated witness token (ID + signed ACK) before we schedule escrow handoff. Jordan, please get the SI contact info.

jordan.partnerships: Partner contact: paula@stratusgrid.com. I'll request SI witness name and org ID in the 3/30 sync.

kevin.sis: Small ops note: include docker-compose snippet + env var list in integration-summary; do NOT include secrets. Put a 'verify.sh' that runs smoke tests and outputs a PASS/FAIL JSON. That helps marketplace reviewers.

nina.legal: Reminder: no joint announcement until the attestation is signed by both parties and Redwood Eng lead confirms no open high/critical findings.

jordan.partnerships: Understood. I'll keep this thread for execution updates. If owners hit blockers DM me.
